stemMarkdown: A thief driving at 30 km/h gets a head start of 3 hours. A police car then sets off along the same road at 50 km/h. How many hours does the police car take to catch the thief? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In 3 hours the thief covers $30 \times 3 = 90$ km. The police close that gap at $50 - 30 = 20$ km/h, taking $\dfrac{90}{20} = 4.5$ hours.
